title: Data Analyst
content: <h2>About the role</h2><p>Kestrel Commerce is hiring a Data Analyst for the returns team in Bengaluru (hybrid, three days in the office).</p><ul><li>2-4 years of experience with SQL and Python for forecasting</li><li>Experience with dbt is a plus</li><li>Build dashboards in Tableau for regional teams</li></ul><p>Work closely with logistics and e-commerce partners.</p>
